title: Automatic deterministic comparative subquery construction
hypothesis: A deterministic constructor can reproduce the selected manually frozen decomposition closely enough for runtime use without adding an LLM call.

variants.description: Previously selected manually frozen per-technology subqueries.
Prefix the unchanged comparative question with an instruction to focus on one technology, then filter retrieval to that language.
Parse the shared topic from supported comparative forms and emit a language-specific documentation query; fall back to focus-original if parsing fails.

controlledVariables: same 8 positive and 8 negative validation cases

tieBreakers: prefer focus-original when every retrieval and cost metric ties
selectionRule.failurePolicy: Retain the manual frozen reference and select no automatic constructor if neither automatic variant satisfies every guardrail.
